# RNODE: Facilitating pre- and postprocessing of phylogenetic analyses

[![language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-R-blue?style=flat&logo=r&logoColor=white)](https://www.r-project.org)
[![author](https://img.shields.io/badge/author-DYM_Nakamura-blue?logo=googlescholar&logoColor=white)](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=c0W8Cm8AAAAJ&hl=en)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL_v3-blue?logo=gnu&logoColor=white)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html)

**RNODE** is an R package to facilitate pre- and postprocessing of
phylogenetic analyses, including (1) comparisons of topologies, branch
lengths, support values, (2) comparison of DNA sequences, (3)
manipulation of cladistic matrices, and (4) manipulation of trees.

Copyright (C) Daniel Y. M. Nakamura 2026

## Cite

If you use **RNODE**, please cite this repository.

## Installation

**RNODE** was tested in R. v. 4.5.2 and can be installed with the
following command:

    devtools::install_github("dnakamuraz/RNODE")

## Usage

For detailed tutorials and examples on how to use these functions,
please refer to the package vignettes available on the website’s
Articles section:

- [Tree
  Comparisons](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/articles/tree-comparisons.html):
  Identifying shared and unique clades, support comparisons, logistic
  regressions, branch lengths, and topological distances.
- [Matrix
  Handling](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/articles/matrix-handling.html):
  Morphological filtering, shared taxa filtering, concatenating
  matrices, and formatting conversions (TNT / NEXUS).
- [Tree
  Manipulation](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/articles/tree-manipulation.html):
  Mapping support values and branch lengths across different trees.

# Package index

## Tree Comparison

Functions to compare topologies, support values, and branch lengths
between phylogenetic trees.

- [`sharedNodes()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/sharedNodes.md)
  : sharedNodes
- [`uniqueNodes()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/uniqueNodes.md)
  : uniqueNodes
- [`retrodictNodes()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/retrodictNodes.md)
  : retrodictNodes
- [`compareBranchLength()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/compareBranchLength.md)
  : compareBranchLength
- [`summaryTopologicalDist()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/summaryTopologicalDist.md)
  : summaryTopologicalDist
- [`multiRF()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/multiRF.md)
  : multiRF
- [`multiCID()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/multiCID.md)
  : multiCID
- [`multiSPR()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/multiSPR.md)
  : multiSPR
- [`normalizedSPR()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/normalizedSPR.md)
  : normalizedSPR

## Tree Handling

Functions for mapping support values and branch lengths across trees,
and for writing tree files.

- [`mapSupport()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/mapSupport.md)
  : mapSupport
- [`mapBranchLength()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/mapBranchLength.md)
  : mapBranchLength
- [`addREP()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/addREP.md) :
  addREP
- [`writeTree()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/writeTree.md)
  : writeTree
- [`howManyPolytomies()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/howManyPolytomies.md)
  : How many Polytomies in a tree

## Taxon Management

Functions for renaming and filtering taxa across matrices and trees.

- [`renameTaxa()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/renameTaxa.md)
  : renameTaxa
- [`filterTaxaList()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/filterTaxaList.md)
  : filterTaxaList

## Matrix Handling

Functions for filtering, concatenating, and converting phylogenetic
matrices (NEXUS / TNT formats).

- [`concatenate()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/concatenate.md)
  : concatenate
- [`filterMissing()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/filterMissing.md)
  : filterMissing
- [`filterInvariants()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/filterInvariants.md)
  : filterInvariants
- [`filterSharedTaxa()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/filterSharedTaxa.md)
  : filterSharedTaxa
- [`splitNoStates()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/splitNoStates.md)
  : splitNoStates
- [`splitOrdFromUnord()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/splitOrdFromUnord.md)
  : splitOrdFromUnord
- [`nex2tnt()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/nex2tnt.md)
  : nex2tnt
- [`tnt2nex()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/tnt2nex.md)
  : tnt2nex
- [`nex2fas()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/nex2fas.md)
  : nex2fas
- [`tnt2fas()`](https://dnakamuraz.github.io/RNODE/reference/tnt2fas.md)
  : tnt2fas

Internal helpers and placeholder functions.
